headline: Leaders fall in the Sunshine State and the Central Atlantic
dek: Wilmington's home defeat to Bridgeport is their fifth of the season. Florida Tech, who led the Sunshine State going into the day, were beaten at Rollins on the same day.
displaced_by: results night: conference leaders Wilmington and Florida Tech both lost
